term: necessary existence by own nature versus accessible-world necessity
resolution: The sourced essential-existence statement distinguishes the explanation by an existent’s own nature from explanation by other natures. NecessaryAt only quantifies existence over accessible worlds. Neither a proof of that modal predicate nor a constant truth distribution by itself establishes own-nature explanation. No source fidelity or formal equivalence is inferred between these meanings; essential facts and instantiated concrete bearers remain distinct.
